headline: OpenAI governance questions intensify as Norway considers acquisition
body: A Norwegian economics publication has proposed government acquisition of OpenAI, while concurrent discussions question the company's risk assessment practices and AI training velocity. The company disbanded its team responsible for evaluating catastrophic model risks, raising concerns about safety oversight as AI systems become more integrated into clinical decision-making. For healthcare AI specifically, these governance and safety questions directly impact vendor reliability and the trustworthiness of models being deployed in EHR systems and patient care workflows. Organizations evaluating AI partnerships should scrutinize vendor risk management practices and long-term institutional stability, particularly as regulatory frameworks around clinical AI continue to develop.
